::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [Before June 1865]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. This fragment printed in <i>[Letters of Alfred Lord Tennyson](other_books/otherbook_396.qmd)</i>,  II,  471
:::

It is in an appendix to collected editions of [Mrs. Hemans](people/person_1936.qmd)’ life and works, where she had made notes of subjects from history suitable to write poems upon, unluckily without saying where they came from. I have watched for this story for years . . . I will write to the friend who owns the copy of Mrs Hemans from which I took it.[^1]

---

[^1]: [Alfred Tennyson](people/person_1874.qmd) had asked [Warburton](people/person_1466.qmd) (later a canon of Winchester but at that date an inspector of schools) to find out from CMY the source of the story, ‘Odin’s Sacrifice’, in the *Book of Golden Deeds*. On 6 June 1865, he quoted this extract from one of two letters he had received from her. Tennyson used the story in his poem 'The Victim'.
